name: Calimemnon Crystal

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond item page in signed-in Chrome on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/magic-items/10771760-calimemnon-crystal. Prices use the existing rarity convention; unspecified weight is 0. Reference-only properties require manual adjudication.

text: Arcane Focus; Fly Speed 30 feet. Cast Create or Destroy Water, Enlarge/Reduce, and Major Image at will (DC 18). Reference-only: hovering and at-will Invisibility on yourself. A Magic action toggles a 20-foot Emanation of cold; each creature other than the attuned bearer takes 2d6 Cold once per turn when the aura enters its space, it enters the aura, or it ends its turn there. While holding the crystal, a Magic action once per dawn distributes six rays among creatures within 60 feet: each ray either heals 2d6+2 HP or deals 6d6+6 Radiant (DC 18 Dexterity for half). Roll one each of the minor/major beneficial and minor/major detrimental artifact properties. Only an attuned bearer casting Wish to destroy the crystal can break it, releasing its imprisoned genies.
